meta.name: Telepathy
meta.description: A humming violet thought-orb that bursts in rings of psychic static. Any enemy tank caught in the rings is yours for its next turn: you aim it, pick from its own arsenal, drive it and pull the trigger. Turn it on its friends, march it off a cliff, or make it spend its nuke on itself. A bot caster turns the victim on its own side. Breaks if you die first.
